**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The agreement imposes no most-favoured-nation obligation on us. Licensor consideration is fully specified as fixed volume-tier per-million fees, the 33% "Supplemental Payments" share, monthly support charges, and the option/rebate share arrangements — none of which requires 551 FX IB Associates to extend SFG terms no less favourable than those given to any third party, or to match a competing offer.

Points checked and cleared:
- Full-text searches for MFN-style language ("most favoured/favored", "favorable", "best price", "pricing", "other customers", "terms offered", "no less", "discount", "competing") returned no hits.
- The fee schedule and Supplemental Payments provisions were read in full to confirm nothing is buried there.
- Article XXII Right of First Refusal (p0139) is the only third-party-offer mechanic, but it attaches to a sale of substantially all assets or a merger of the Licensee — a change-of-control/ROFR issue, not a pricing MFN. I have flagged it in the rationale rather than under this rule, to avoid double-flagging the same term.

This sits at the preferred position (no MFN burdening the Customer), so nothing to redline here.
